We can do both: extend the trial 21 days and issue a $15k promotional credit. A couple of logistics items so accounting can ingest cleanly:

- For ledger ingestion, please confirm the PO number you want referenced on the credit memo; otherwise we will reference the HubSpot deal id (D-83412-OPT).
- I'll loop in Finance (Laura) to propose the GLA mapping and whether this should hit revenue contra (Allowance for Promotions) vs a contra-revenue (Sales Discounts) classification.

Looping in Aditya and Laura — Aditya, can you confirm sales approval? Laura, can you propose the journal entry and whether we should surface this as a proforma credit (no cash effect) vs an invoiced credit memo that reduces AR?

I'll start the trial extension now and confirm when it's active.

— Soojin

Thanks — quick finance take. Summary of recommended path for clean audit trail:

1) Issue a formal credit memo (Credit Memo CM-2028-0422-OPT) referencing the HubSpot deal id D-83412-OPT and including the OptiScale PO if they provide one. This reduces the outstanding AR when applied to a subsequent invoice.

2) Accounting classification: book as contra-revenue under account 4200-SalesDiscounts (we map promo credits to contra-revenue for transparency in ARR movement). We will also tag the credit memo with a subledger code 'PROMO-TRIAL-2028' to allow rollups.

3) Journal entry when credit applied to invoice:
- Dr. Sales Discounts (4200) $15,000
- Cr. Accounts Receivable (1100) $15,000

If we choose invoice-offset (netting against the first billing invoice rather than issuing a standalone credit memo), the external presentation is the same but internal controls around approvals differ — credit memo path requires a sales approval email + procurement PO.

4) Recommend we deliver the credit memo PDF to procurement and upload the backing docs to the Drive folder (linked below). Marcus will prepare the CSV with the MAAP mapping for ingestion.

I attached the Credit_Request_Form template — please have OptiScale confirm PO or signatory so we can finalize.

Laura Bennett
Senior Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
